name: Token Risk API
description: BEP-20 token risk checks, pay per call in USDC. Built for autonomous agents. No account, no API key, no signup.

skills.name: Scan a BEP-20 token
skills.description: Checks owner(), paused(), blacklist selectors, mint selectors and code size. Returns a risk verdict, a score out of 10, and an explicit list of what the analysis cannot determine.
examples: Check this token for a hidden mint function.

skills.name: Scan up to 20 tokens at once
skills.description: Same checks as scan-token, applied to a list of up to 20 addresses in a single call.

skills.name: Audit token approvals
skills.description: Reports token balances worth reviewing for unlimited allowances. Points to revoke.cash for the complete audit.

limits.statement: This service does not prove a token is safe. It reads what is readable on-chain. Tax cannot be measured by static analysis. Every response includes its own limitations.
